headline: A 2026 executive order titled "Strengthening Customs Enforcement" deals with how the government enforces customs rules on imports.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal agencies to increase or change how they enforce customs laws, which govern goods coming into the United States. No summary of the order's specific steps was provided, so its exact requirements are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that import goods into the United States
who_it_affects.how: They may face changes in how customs rules on their shipments are checked or enforced.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. Customs and Border Protection and related federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to change or step up their customs enforcement work.
